difficultyAxis: Attribute width and constraint variety: four entities carrying up to fourteen attributes each and spanning the whole declarative-validation vocabulary, including a collection-typed attribute.
rationale: An insurance policy service. Policy alone carries fourteen attributes covering text, integral, decimal, temporal, boolean and collection types, and the validation rules span required, length, pattern, email, numeric-range, decimal-range, temporal and collection constraints. Every declared constraint must be honoured and no undeclared one invented, so a generator that falls back to a small fixed annotation set is visibly wrong here while a two-attribute fixture hides it.

userStories.intent: register a policy holder with contact and identity details
userStories.benefit: the holder can be underwritten and contacted

scenarios.given: a full name, an email address, a national identifier and a date of birth in the past
scenarios.then: the holder is persisted and returned with its generated identifier

scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the holder
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid before reaching the service layer

scenarios.given: a date of birth in the future
scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the holder
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: issue a policy with a sum insured, a premium and a coverage set
userStories.benefit: the holder is covered from a known effective date

scenarios.given: a policy number matching the permitted pattern, at least one coverage code and a sum insured within the permitted band
scenarios.then: the policy is persisted with every declared attribute and returned with its identifier

scenarios.when: the underwriter attempts to issue the policy
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

scenarios.given: a sum insured above the permitted maximum
scenarios.when: the underwriter attempts to issue the policy
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

scenarios.given: an annual premium that is zero or negative
scenarios.when: the underwriter attempts to issue the policy
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: attach an instalment schedule to a policy
userStories.benefit: premium collection is planned in advance

scenarios.given: an existing policy and a positive instalment amount
scenarios.then: the instalment is persisted against the policy

scenarios.given: an instalment number below the permitted minimum
scenarios.when: the underwriter attempts to record the instalment
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: register a claim against an existing policy
userStories.benefit: the loss is recorded and can be assessed

scenarios.given: an existing policy, an incident date in the past and a positive claimed amount
scenarios.then: the claim is persisted and returned with its identifier

scenarios.given: an incident date in the future
scenarios.when: the assessor attempts to register the claim
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

scenarios.given: a claimed amount that is zero or negative
scenarios.when: the assessor attempts to register the claim
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: record the approved amount and settle a claim
userStories.benefit: the payout is agreed and closed

scenarios.given: an existing unsettled claim and an approved amount not exceeding the claimed amount
scenarios.then: the claim is persisted with its approved amount and settled state

scenarios.given: an approved amount greater than the claimed amount
scenarios.when: the assessor attempts to settle the claim
scenarios.then: the service rejects the settlement as inconsistent

scenarios.given: a claim identifier that does not exist
scenarios.then: the service reports the claim as not found

userStories.intent: retrieve the instalment schedule for a policy

scenarios.given: a policy with no recorded instalments
scenarios.then: the service returns an empty collection rather than reporting an error

scenarios.given: a policy identifier that does not exist
scenarios.then: the service reports the policy as not found
